algorithm.pixels: Native RGB; no resizing or grayscale conversion.
algorithm.ink: Any RGB channel >32; formula ink is counted only inside the formula region.
algorithm.bbox: Inclusive occupied formula-region bbox height: max_y-min_y+1.
algorithm.segments: FORMULA_SEGMENT occupancy recorded separately; slot statistics NOT_APPLICABLE.
algorithm.median: Middle value if odd; exact arithmetic mean of middle two if even.
algorithm.canvas_edge: Any native RGB ink in the outer 3 pixel rows or columns is a structural edge flag.
algorithm.limits: Formula occupancy and canvas-edge flags do not certify glyph size, symbols, or segment completeness.
